Quick Wins — This Week

Experiment A1

Rationale · A1

Success Benchmarks

A higher mean is a signal for replication, not proof of causation or a promised gain. Reach and engagement are proxies, not verified sales or audience trust.

Success measure · A1

Compare mean reach per post in A versus B at the same post age. Report sample sizes and missing values. Historical reference: 975 from 4 measured VIDEO posts (CALC#VIDEO-reach).
